decisions.reason: Because the dismantling joint is close to the core pipeline business and can be carried with limited extra resource commitment, management would likely keep it unless clearer evidence emerges that it persistently falls below aspiration levels.

Although the earlier withdrawal of a related bracket raises concern, this bracket is still near the established offer and would likely be retained while management monitors whether its results justify continued attention.

As a distant single-product diversification with uncertain evidence of traction, this waste bin is the kind of offering management would cut if it does not clearly meet aspirations relative to stronger uses of capacity in the core business.

Because this waste-bin-with-ashtray line has several models and fits the firm's municipal customer base, management would likely give it more time under existing slack even though it remains outside the core offer.

Outdoor public ashtrays are comparatively peripheral and easier to sacrifice, so if their performance is still uncertain management would likely reallocate those resources to core products or more promising development projects.
